name: 26534-tritonfp8decode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1. An 8B checkpoint fits one 80 GB card and no parallelism flag is set.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, bounded at 100 requests / 900 s safety, warmup the first 10% by completion, seed static 26534.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix bucket. Prompt exactly 1000 tokens, output exactly 200, greedy (temperature 0.0), no shared prefix.
purpose: A single-user document summarizer turning thousand-token articles into 200-token summaries with an 8B model on one GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit e5b438a24786decebd0b69340f024f18ea184d44 (vLLM v0.11.1rc1-57).
# One environment variable is also part of this declaration and cannot live in this file --
# see configs/tuned.yaml, and read it before running anything.

# Ungated mirror of a gated repo; same weights.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

kv-cache-dtype: fp8

# Prefix caching is ON by default on this engine, so this line does real work, and it is a VALIDITY
# condition: with caching on, how many prompt tokens a request actually prefills becomes a function
# of arrival order and cache residency rather than the declared prompt length.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# ONE LINE OF INLINE JSON, NOT A BLOCK MAPPING, AND THAT IS LOAD-BEARING: the reader of this file
# skips indented lines, so written block-style the key parses to nothing, the engine launches on
# its own default compile config, and it still reports rc=0.
compilation-config: {"compile_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8], "cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8], "cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Do not add `enforce-eager`: the compilation config above is part of the declared setup, not a
# performance knob layered on top of it. There is no attention-backend engine-arg at this commit.
